features: 160W boAt Signature Sound: Elevate your home entertainment with the boAt Aavante 2.1 1650 Soundbar. Powerful 160W boAt Signature Sound delivers deep bass and rich audio, making your movie nights truly cinematic.

2.1-Channel with Wireless Subwoofer: Featuring a 2.1-channel setup and a wireless subwoofer, this soundbar delivers room-filling sound that envelops you from every angle, no matter where you’re seated.

Multi-Connectivity Modes: Enjoy effortless pairing with Bluetooth v5.4 and take advantage of multiple wired options like AUX, Optical, HDMI (ARC), and USB, for seamless audio streaming across various devices.

EQ Modes: Whether you’re watching a movie, listening to music, catching up on the news, or exploring 3D content, the four dedicated EQ modes - Music, Movies, News, and 3D offer tailored sound for every moment.
Adjustable Bass and Treble: Fine-tune your listening experience with ease. Remote-controlled bass and treble settings allow you to customize the audio output exactly the way you like it.
All-in-One Master Remote: Take full command of your soundbar with the all-purpose remote. Adjust volume, skip tracks, switch modes, and more, right from the comfort of your seat.
Modern Sleek Aesthetic: Designed to impress, the sleek form of this soundbar adds a touch of sophistication to your living space with its premium finish.
Wall-Mount Ready: boAt Aavante 2.1 1650 offers flexibility in placement as you can either place it on a surface or mount it on the wall for an organized and space-saving setup.
description: Experience sound like never before with the boAt Aavante 2.1 1650 Bluetooth Soundbar, your gateway to immersive audio. Bass-rich boAt Signature Sound transforms your entertainment zone, making movie nights and binge sessions more dynamic. With 160W of intense audio output, every high-speed chase or dramatic scene feels lifelike and thrilling. Groove to your favorite tracks with the 2.1-channel sound system and wireless subwoofer that deliver deep, resonant sound for dance-offs, gaming marathons, or chilled evenings with friends. Enjoy seamless connectivity with Bluetooth v5.4 and an array of input options, including AUX, optical, USB, and HDMI (ARC), so your devices always stay plugged into premium audio. Switch up your sound effortlessly with four dedicated EQ modes, such as Music, Movies, News, and 3D, that adapt to your content and boost your listening experience. In addition, you can adjust the sound your way with the master remote and control volume, EQ modes, etc., without leaving your couch.
